name: browser-use
headline: Seedream-image-mcp - AI Image Generation for Cursor
short_description: Seedream-image-mcp integrates SeeDream 4.0 for AI image generation in Cursor and Claude Code. It automates high-quality image creation with customizable dimensions and smart reference images, eliminating the need for complex prompts. Ideal for operations teams needing visual content generation.
author: wearzdk

sections.overview:
SeeDream-image-mcp is an MCP tool that automates image generation using Volcano Engine's SeeDream 4.0 model, designed for integration with Cursor and Claude Desktop. Instead of writing complex prompts, users describe what they need and the tool automatically generates appropriate image prompts and creates visual content. The skill supports customizable image dimensions and smart reference images, making it useful for teams that need to produce visual assets quickly. Generated images are accessible via direct links, though the README notes that links expire after 24 hours when using the local version. A cloud-hosted alternative is available that offers permanent CDN storage and additional features like WebP compression and background removal.
Generate illustrations for web pages and design mockups
Create visual assets for marketing content and social media
Produce concept artwork for product design workflows
Automate image creation for documentation and presentations
sections.setup:

sections.usage:
```
Generate an image of a [OBJECT] in a [STYLE] setting. The image should be [DIMENSIONS] pixels. Use [REFERENCE_IMAGE] as a reference for composition and style.
```
